meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前工作区外独立开发新功能
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on a new feature without affecting your current workspace

howto.what: Claude 会先检查当前项目是否已在独立工作区。若没有,则创建(优先系统自带工具,否则 git worktree),再装依赖、跑测试并报告。若创建被阻止,它会在当前目录继续并告知你。
howto.when: 当你要开始需要与当前工作区隔离的新功能开发,或准备执行实施计划前,Claude 会主动检查隔离工作区是否存在。

say.text: 开始开发登录功能,先建隔离工作区。
say.note: Claude 会检查现状并创建或复用工作区,再运行测试。

say.text: 我要改订单模块,确认隔离环境是否就绪。
say.note: Claude 会检测当前是否已隔离,必要时创建。

say.text: 不要新建工作区,就在当前目录开发。
say.note: Claude 会尊重你的选择,在当前目录继续。

howto.what_en: Claude checks if the current project is already in an isolated worktree. If not, it creates one (native tool first, git fallback), installs dependencies, runs tests, and reports. If blocked, it works in place and informs you.
howto.when_en: Claude activates when you start feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace, or before executing implementation plans.

say_en.text: Start developing the login feature; set up an isolated worktree first.
say_en.note: Claude checks and creates or reuses a worktree, then runs tests.

say_en.text: I'm going to modify the order module; verify the isolated environment is ready.
say_en.note: Claude checks current isolation and creates one if needed.

say_en.text: Don't create a new worktree; just develop in the current directory.
say_en.note: Claude honors your choice and proceeds in place.
